Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body:
Shadow Strike Reads
>
> [obt] Strike: strength ranged damage, with an optional maneuver.
> [OBT] As above, with an optional press.
>
May I select that strike during strike selection (not having used the maneuver) can I use the maneuver on another round of combat?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
No.

Rulebook 6.4.2: "If a combat card played by a minion has a maneuver as part of an effect, the maneuver must be used that round of combat."
